description: Bounded candidate records retained for the conventional inventory; not selectable content.

full_official_identity_inventory.name: 恩怨
full_official_identity_inventory.rule_text: 锁定技，其他角色每令你回复1点体力。该角色摸一张牌；其他角色每对你造成一次伤害，须给你一张（红桃）手牌，否则该角色失去一点体力。

full_official_identity_inventory.name: 眩惑
full_official_identity_inventory.rule_text: 出牌阶段，你可将一张（红桃）手牌交给一名其他角色，然后，你获得该角色的一张牌并立即交给除该角色外的其他角色，每回合限一次。

quarantined_candidates.blocker: Official oldXuanhuo says obtained card immediately given to actors excluding original target, potentially includes self; BWIKI says another other actor, potentially excludes FaZheng. Official quota eachTURN versus BWIKI eachPLAYPHASE matters with genuine extra phases. Do not silently use modern draw-replacement Enyuan/Xuanhuo.

full_official_identity_inventory.name: 陷阵
full_official_identity_inventory.rule_text: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以与一名角色拼点。若你赢，直到回合结束，你无视该角色的防具，且对该角色使用牌没有距离和次数限制；若你没赢，本回合你不能使用【杀】。

full_official_identity_inventory.name: 禁酒
full_official_identity_inventory.rule_text: 锁定技，你的【酒】只能当做【杀】。
